name: Thriveworks
one_liner: ✓ Clinician-founded W2 employer with 340+ locations, no-show protection, and benefits. 2.3/5 compensation rating—PTO limited to 8 hrs/month.
short_description: Thriveworks is a mental health company employing therapists, psychologists, and psychiatrists across 340+ US locations with W2 positions, benefits, and no-show protection.
long_description: Thriveworks is a clinician-founded mental health company with over 16 years of experience operating 340+ locations across the United States. The company offers both W2 employee and 1099 contractor positions for licensed therapists, psychologists, counselors, and psychiatric providers. Key benefits include no-show protection (clinicians get paid when insured clients no-show or late cancel), health insurance through Anthem (50% subsidized for employees), paid liability insurance, and retirement savings plans. PTO accrues at 8 hours per month with up to 80 hours carryover. Average salaries range from $75,000-$140,000 for counselors and therapists, with PMHNPs earning up to $150,000. Thriveworks supports hybrid care models with flexibility for early morning, evening, and weekend scheduling. The company handles insurance billing, credentialing, marketing, and client scheduling, allowing clinicians to focus on patient care.

Clinicians seeking no-show protection and guaranteed pay

not_for: Therapists seeking competitive compensation (2.3/5 rating on Comparably)

Those wanting to build their own private practice brand
Therapists seeking higher earnings (private practice can pay 30-50% more)
Clinicians wanting full autonomy over caseload and client selection

faqs.q: How much do Thriveworks therapists make?
faqs.a: Thriveworks advertises counselor salaries of $75,000-$140,000, but compensation ratings are low (2.3/5 on Comparably, 2.1/5 on Glassdoor). Many therapists report effective salaries closer to $65,000-$85,000. PMHNPs can earn up to $150,000. The W2 model trades potentially higher private practice earnings for stability and benefits.

Thriveworks has a 2.3/5 compensation rating on Comparably and 2.1/5 from counselors on Glassdoor. This is below average for the mental health industry. Many therapists cite pay as a primary concern, though the W2 benefits package (health insurance, no-show protection) adds ~$10-15k in value.

faqs.q: Does Thriveworks offer W2 or 1099 positions?
faqs.a: Thriveworks offers both W2 employee positions with benefits and 1099 contractor arrangements. W2 employees receive health insurance (50% subsidized through Anthem), no-show protection, paid liability insurance, and 401k. The tradeoff is less autonomy and potentially lower earnings than private practice.

faqs.q: How much PTO does Thriveworks offer?
faqs.a: Thriveworks PTO accrues at 8 hours per month (about 12 days per year) with an 80-hour carryover cap. This is below the industry average of 15-20 PTO days. The limited PTO is a common complaint among employees.

Thriveworks pays clinicians when private insured and self-pay clients no-show or late cancel. This provides income stability that independent practice doesn't offer. Note: this only applies to certain client types, not all appointments.

faqs.q: How does Thriveworks compare to private practice?
faqs.a: Private practice therapists often earn 30-50% more per session but lack benefits, face income volatility, and handle their own billing. Thriveworks provides W2 stability, benefits valued at ~$10-15k/year, and no-show protection. Calculate your personal breakeven to decide which model fits.
